title: films / directors with a similar philosophy to WKW?

commenti.body:
John Cassavetes was all about spontaneity in life and how his movies could be a blueprint for showing people how to do that.

I would recommend Husbands, Faces, Minnie & Moskowitz for that. His other films are generally about how society represses expression. But the pathos and style of these films are very different from WKW.

Charlie Chaplin deals a lot with authenticity and spontaneity in his works.

Frank Capra as well. Actually, I would recommend Frank Capra most of all, especially You Can't Take It With You and It Happened One Night.


Luchino Visconti's La Notte Bianche will also give you this feeling. Especially the dance scene.
